workflows.trigger: A governed Context submits one registered Context Selector for its declared intended use.
preconditions: D65-S2 Product Capability and product ontology are admitted
business ontology and binding are admitted before operational use
selector and binding are version exact

steps.action: resolve Context identity, selector, and binding
resolve projection profile, cut policy, and governance join policy
resolve and verify one complete Canonical Event Cut
verify required subject and relation endpoints at that cut
resolve exact governance events required by the join policy
calculate the derivative projection from selector and cut
collect all delivery validations and provenance
deliver the projection or reject it with typed failures and challenge routes

workflows.owner_route: business-ontology owner plus Context product owner

workflows.trigger: A consumer or validator submits an evidence, contradiction, or owner-review challenge against a load-bearing bridge subject or projection claim.
preconditions: challenge contract and residue destination resolve

steps.action: validate challenged subject and challenge mode
resolve responsible owner, resolution gate, dependent uses, and residue route
block only declared dependent uses and successors while unresolved
record owner resolution, superseding semantic event, or typed unresolved residue without rewriting history
re-evaluate affected bindings and projections against the new exact epoch

workflows.owner_route: challenged subject owner plus business-ontology owner
workflows.challenge_route: Definitions-governance owner plus challenged subject owner
